full_description:
Cache Vault is a local-first clipboard vault for Windows. It helps you save, search, organize, and reuse clipboard history without requiring an account, cloud sync, or a subscription.

The free version includes a usable clipboard vault, Quick Paste menu, smart folders, favorites, and image/code/text organization.

Founder Edition adds advanced proof and export workflows for users who want stronger receipts, organized vault exports, and release verification.

Key features:

* Local-first clipboard vault
* Searchable clip history
* Quick Paste menu
* Smart folders (Recent, URLs, Images, Code, From Phone, and more)
* Favorites and organization
* Proof receipts and SHA256-verified release exports (Founder Edition)
* No account required
* No cloud requirement
* No subscription
